children: Robinhood's token issuance platform Pons said creators on the platform have collectively earned more than $25 million in trading fee revenue. According to ChainCatcher, the fees can be paid in stock tokens, ETH, or the USDG stablecoin, giving creators multiple settlement options.
Pons also said the team is preparing a new batch of stock tokens for potential listing, but it has not disclosed the specific assets or launch timing.

title: Robinhood's Pons Says Token Creators Have Earned Over $25 Million in Fees
